title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description:
You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i`-th day.

You want to maximize your profit by choosing a **single day** to buy one stock and choosing a **different day in the future** to sell that stock. Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction. If no positive profit is possible, return `0`.
hints: If you decide to sell on day `i`, the best day to have bought is the day with the minimum price among days `0..i-1`.
Track the running minimum price seen so far as you scan left to right, and update the maximum profit `prices[i] - minPrice` at each step.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 1 (price = 1) and sell on day 4 (price = 6), profit = 6 - 1 = 5.
Prices only decrease, so no profitable transaction can be made; return 0.
Buy on day 0 (price = 2) and sell on day 1 (price = 4) for profit 2. You cannot buy at 1 and sell earlier at 4.
